declared: 2026-09-13, before any measurement of the correction route
purpose: Production gates for a Japanese-to-Traditional-Chinese route: HY-MT1.5 1.8B immediate captions plus optional Hy-MT2 7B final correction. All gates must pass; any failure keeps the route out of production.

latency.baseline: 1.8B-only run on the same corpus, same machine, same session, measured immediately before the route run

correction.counts: only corrections whose text differs from the immediate translation

ordering.rule: a correction for a segment is published only while that segment is still the newest finalized caption

quality.requirement: counting only corrections that land within the deadline; no correction may introduce a negation, speaker-intent or invented-content error that the immediate translation did not have
